body: Session-validation gate **infrastructure** + **password expiry** shipped in #2388 (REST surface, `enforceAuth`). Remaining on this seam: **enforced MFA (D3)** reuses it (in progress), and the **dispatcher/MCP** gate path is still TODO.

Enforced MFA (D3) shipped in #2390 — completes the session-validation gate. **ADR-0069 P1 is now complete** (HIBP / lockout+rate-limit / complexity / history / expiry / MFA). Remaining on this issue: per-org `sys_organization.require_mfa`, the **objectui** TOTP-enroll prompt on `403 MFA_REQUIRED`, the dispatcher/MCP gate path, and P2/P3.

✅ **objectui remediation UI shipped** in objectstack-ai/objectui#2037 — the Console now detects `403 MFA_REQUIRED` / `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` and shows a full-screen guided flow (TOTP enrollment with QR + backup codes, or expired-password change), then reloads. Browser-verified end-to-end (enroll → verify real TOTP → gate clears → app loads). Enforced MFA is now usable end-to-end. Remaining: per-org `require_mfa`, dispatcher/MCP gate path, P2/P3.

✅ **Per-org `sys_organization.require_mfa` + the dispatcher/MCP gate** shipped in #2395. Enforced MFA is now complete across all surfaces (global + per-org enforcement; REST/Console gate #2388; dispatcher/MCP gate; objectui remediation UI objectstack-ai/objectui#2037). Remaining on this issue is **P2** (session controls / IP allowlist / OIDC trust-list) and **P3** (SAML).

✅ **P2 session controls** (idle timeout / absolute max lifetime / concurrent-session cap) shipped in #2397 — `sys_session.{last_activity_at,revoked_at,revoke_reason}` + the 3 settings; idle/absolute enforced in customSession (revoke = expire-in-place), concurrent cap on sign-in. Remaining: P2 **IP allowlist** + **OIDC trust-list UI**, P3 **SAML**.

**OIDC trust-list UI (P2 / D6) — already implemented; no work needed.** Browser-verified on current main: Setup → Access Control → **SSO Providers** exists (#2389) with a **Register SSO Provider** form carrying first-class fields — Provider ID, Issuer URL, Email Domain, **Client ID**, **Client Secret** (encrypted at rest by better-auth), Discovery URL, Scopes, and User-ID/Email/Name claim mapping — wired to the `@better-auth/sso` plugin's `/sso/register` (registers into `sys_sso_provider` and goes live for login). This is the admin-managed OIDC trust list ADR-0069 D6 asked for; it is correctly an object-CRUD surface, **not** a flat settings page. Remaining: P2 **IP allowlist**, P3 **SAML**.

✅ **P2 IP allow-list (D5)** shipped in #2401 — `allowed_ip_ranges` setting + a Hono middleware ahead of better-auth that rejects auth requests from out-of-range client IPs (trust-proxy aware, /config exempt, fail-open on undetermined IP). Gates the **auth routes**; all-request IP gating + per-org `allowed_ip_ranges` + `require_ip_match` are follow-ups. **Remaining ADR-0069 work: P3 SAML only** (needs a `@better-auth/sso` vs custom-plugin decision).

### ✅ SAML 2.0 SSO (P3) — done in #2404 (merged)

The last open item on this tracker — **SAML federation** — is shipped.

**Key finding:** `@better-auth/sso@1.6.20` (the same package already powering the OIDC trust list) ships **full SAML 2.0** (samlify-backed). The ADR's original "SAML is out of better-auth core" premise was stale, so **no custom plugin** was needed — SAML registers through the *same* `/sso/register` endpoint with a nested `samlConfig`, and the package serves `/sso/saml2/sp/metadata` + `/sso/saml2/sp/acs/:providerId`.

What shipped:
- `register_saml_provider` action on `sys_sso_provider` (Setup → SSO Providers), collecting flat IdP fields.
- `runRegisterSamlProviderFromForm` bridge + `/admin/sso/register-saml` admin route — reshapes flat → nested `samlConfig`, derives the per-provider ACS URL, re-dispatches through `/sso/register` (admin gate enforced), returns SP ACS + metadata URLs.
- ADR-0069 addendum correcting the premise.

Verified E2E: register → persisted with `saml_config`; SP metadata serves valid `EntityDescriptor`/`SPSSODescriptor`; `/sign-in/sso` produces a valid `SAMLRequest` redirect to the IdP.

---

With this, **every item on this tracker (and ADR-0069 P1/P2/P3) is implemented and merged.** Closing.
